data.content:
* * *

## [I’m quite disappointed…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a54d0ddb6b6bd2f5896b9ea)
I’m quite disappointed with my experience. I placed the order for an item marked as available and ready to ship, only to receive a notification a week later that it was canceled and refunded. When I went to their website to review, i saw the same item was still shown as available and for sale online. The disconnect on what is available feels unreliable and has created some distrust on making future orders. I also believe that if your shipping policies don’t match the practice, the company shouldn’t be charging for shipping. I expected for the remainder of my order to be processed within the delivery window that was specified and it came much later than expected. As much as i love the look and feel of Lulu and Georgia, it makes it hard for me to place another order for unreliable service.

July 1, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 13, 2026

Hi there,

We sincerely apologize for the frustration surrounding your canceled item and the subsequent delivery delays with the remainder of your order. We completely understand how a disconnect like this can impact your confidence in shopping with us.

Our team is actively looking into the inventory and shipping concerns you raised.
